metadata.question: In January 2021, did Nambia experience over 7 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Namibia in January 2021, specifically if it experienced over 7 inches of rainfall. 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is good for rainfall analysis - Date: January 2021 (2021-01-01 to 2021-01-31) - Location: Namibia - I'll create a polygon covering Namibia 2. Masking strategy: - For rainfall data, no cloud masking needed since CHIRPS is already processed precipitation data 3. Logic: - Get total precipitation for January 2021 - Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) - Check if total > 7 inches - Handle cases where data might be missing or invalid Let me structure the code: - Define Namibia geometry - Get CHIRPS collection for January 2021 - Check if collection has data - Calculate total precipitation - Convert to inches - Validate and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[11.734, -17.475], [11.734, -28.969], [25.254, -28.969], [25.254, -17.475]] ]); const startDate = '2021-01-01'; const endDate = '2021-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(namibia); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2021 Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate total precipitation const totalPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: namibia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation and convert to inches const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: namibia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = meanPrecip / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || meanPrecip === undefined || !isFinite(meanPrecip)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches > 7) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
